blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The provincial government of Dinagat Islands broke ground on Friday, Oct. 16, for two major infrastructure projects worth a combined P164 million aimed at boosting the local food security and ecotourism. Gov. Nilo P. Demerey Jr. presided over the ceremonies in Barangay Llamera in Libjo town, marking the formal start of civil works for a P64.5-million Provincial Soil Laboratory and the P99.68-million Gaas Inlet boardwalk. Funded under the National Soil Health Program of the Department of Agriculture’s Bureau of Soils and Water Management (DA-BSWM), the soil testing facility will provide diagnostic testing and scientific soil […]...
